items.headline: Anthropic reportedly buys $3.4 billion of gas generators for data centers
points: Unconfirmed: the Financial Times reports that Anthropic struck a $3.4 billion deal for gas-fired power at its data centres.
Dealroom and ShiftDelete say the deal covers 1.7 GW, and Dealroom says Anthropic is taking over OnePWR's Caterpillar orders.
Reuters, Bloomberg and others are relaying the FT report. None of the cited items is an Anthropic post.
